Last night was one of the scariest nights I have had in a while knowing that my home address and most of my personal information was easily accessible to those who wish to do me harm.

Doxxing only serves to silence opinions that are unpopular, such as defending law enforcement instead of calling for mob justice. It is my fault for being young and dumb and posting a little too much information online, but that in no way makes it right to use that information to attempt to terrorize me into changing my position or into leaving Voat.

Voat is having a hard time with places like PayPal and server host, and whether we like it or not Voat is at the mercy of those places. If we want to continue to have a community of free speech, we need to stop giving ammunition to those that wish to inhibit our free speech. /v/jailbait was clearly a sub that provided an excuse for providers to stop providing Voat with services. We need to remember that @Atko and @PuttitOut are just average people that have been thrust into a public spotlight. They have no real legal team and are managing a quickly growing site by the seat of their pants. I am confident that @Atko and @PuttitOut will put free speech ahead of any personal desires they have.

If we want to have a bright future for Voat, we need to make sure the long term goal of always having a free speech platform is a higher priority than a few guys looking at revealing photos of young women. For example, (assuming the date being 24th June 2015):

  • We have not received any requests regarding user information - 24th June 2015
  • We have not been instructed to assist in any legal investigations - 23th June 2015
  • We are not currently being investigated by authorities - 24th June 2015

With the above example we users could tell something regarding a legal investigation has happened yesterday/today and the website has been ordered not to publicly release any information about it. A gag order does not mean you are prevented from not doing something (not updating the date), just prevented from spreading information.
A potential future practice voat could do to alert their users if any legal action has occurred against them and they have been gagged.
